shortDescription: Snapshot management of instances in Proxmox VE cluster

options.name: api_host
options.description: Specify the target host of the Proxmox VE cluster. Uses the E(PROXMOX_HOST) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_otp
options.description: Specify the OTP. Uses the E(PROXMOX_OTP) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_password
options.description: Specify the password to authenticate with. Uses the E(PROXMOX_PASSWORD) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_port
options.description: Specify the target port of the Proxmox VE cluster. Uses the E(PROXMOX_PORT) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: Time limit for requests towards the Proxmox VE API.

options.name: api_token_id
options.description: Specify the token ID. Uses the E(PROXMOX_TOKEN_ID) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_token_secret
options.description: Specify the token secret. Uses the E(PROXMOX_TOKEN_SECRET) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_user
options.description: Specify the user to authenticate with. Uses the E(PROXMOX_USER) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: Path to a local certificate, which will be used to verify TLS connections. Ignored if O(validate_certs=false).

options.name: description
options.description: Specify the description for the snapshot. Only used on the configuration web interface. This is saved as a comment inside the configuration file.

options.name: force
options.description: For removal from config file, even if removing disk snapshot fails.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The instance name.

options.name: retention
options.description: Remove old snapshots if there are more than O(retention) snapshots. If O(retention) is set to V(0), all snapshots will be kept. This is only used when O(state=present) and when an actual snapshot is created. If no snapshot is created, all existing snapshots will be kept.

options.name: snapname
options.description: Name of the snapshot that has to be created/deleted/restored.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the instance snapshot.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Timeout for operations.

options.name: unbind
options.description: This option only applies to LXC containers. Allows to snapshot a container even if it has configured mountpoints. Temporarily disables all configured mountpoints, takes snapshot, and finally restores original configuration. If running, the container will be stopped and restarted to apply config changes. Due to restrictions in the Proxmox API this option can only be used authenticating as V(root@pam) with O(api_password), API tokens do not work either. See U(https://pve.proxmox.com/pve-docs/api-v

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validate the TLS certificates used for the connection to the Proxmox VE API. May be set through the environment variable E(PROXMOX_VALIDATE_CERTS).

options.name: vmid
options.description: The instance ID. If not set, will be fetched from PromoxAPI based on the hostname.

options.name: vmstate
options.description: Snapshot includes RAM.
